WF-03 Step 7: Update documentation for ISS-0607 resolution.

1. Mark ISS-0607 as RESOLVED in docs/issues/ISS-0607.json:
   - status: RESOLVED
   - resolved_at: (current UTC timestamp)
   - resolution: Summary of pg.zig stderr suppression fix
   - prevention: Note about -Dlog-pg-errors build flag for debugging

2. Update CHANGELOG.md:
   Add entry under ## [Unreleased]:

Added `-Dlog-pg-errors` build flag (default false) to gate PostgreSQL error messages that were causing zig test runner to abort on negative tests. Regression test at tests/integration/iss0607_pg_stderr_suppression_test.zig. Related to GH-537 / ISS-0605.

3. Commit documentation changes to feature branch.

Return PASS when complete.
